title: 180-day loan activation rate, 2023 cohort
prompt: Of customers who joined in 2023, what fraction opened a loan within 180 days of joining?
metricDefinition: customers (joined in 2023) with a loan originated within 180 days of joined_at, divided by all customers who joined in 2023.
transformationPlan: filter to customers who joined in 2023
for each, check whether they have a loan originated within 180 days of joining
referenceSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.originated_at >= c.joined_at AND l.originated_at < c.joined_at + INTERVAL '180 days'))::DOUBLE / count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS loan_activation_rate FROM customers c WHERE c.joined_at >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND c.joined_at < DATE '2024-01-01'
